title: Split Two Strings to Make Palindrome
goal: Decide whether a prefix from one string and a suffix from the other can form a palindrome.
strategy: Match outer characters across the two strings until they disagree. At that point the untouched center must be a palindrome entirely within either original string. Try both prefix directions.
